name: theysaid
description: TheySaid helps teams explore customer feedback, analyze projects and responses, prepare and run AI usability tests, monitor progress, and review actionable findings through ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: TheySaid is a productivity tool for product, UX and research teams: it turns customer research into decisions without leaving ChatGPT. Ask about your TheySaid research projects to get themes, ratings, recommendations and supporting quotes, search responses and full conversation transcripts, and compare projects and trends with charts. Plan an AI usability test on any public website or design, review and edit the plan, and launch it only when you approve. Then get prioritized usability issues with paste-ready fix prompts. Requires a TheySaid account.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the top findings from my research projects.
Find negative checkout feedback from the last 30 days.
Help me plan a usability test for my website.
